newsitem.title: USA: Miller Building Systems wins school pact.
newsitem.headline: Miller Building Systems wins school pact.

text.p: Miller Building Systems Inc said Monday its Miller Structures division won a contract to build 50 portable classroom units for use in the Northeast.
Financial terms of the deal were not announced.

Miller said it will serve as the subcontractor building the modules for an unidentified supplier of portable and modular classrooms. The units will be built at three Miller plants during the late winter, spring and early summer periods, Miller said.
Miller designs and makes building modules. Its shares closed down 5/16 Monday at 8-1/4.
